method: identifier is 'free' when it is neither bound by the header's own binder groups nor equal to any mathlib declaration name or name component; such identifiers come from ambient `variable`/`section` declarations that corpus.jsonl does not record
caveat: conservative: any identifier that coincides with a mathlib name component is counted as resolved, so the true incompleteness rate is HIGHER than reported

examples.name: Ordinal.mem_closure_iff_sup
examples.header:
theorem mem_closure_iff_sup :
    a ∈ closure s ↔
      ∃ (ι : Type u) (_ : Nonempty ι) (f : ι → Ordinal), (∀ i, f i ∈ s) ∧ sup.{u, u} f = a

examples.name: Ordinal.mem_closed_iff_sup
examples.header:
theorem mem_closed_iff_sup (hs : IsClosed s) :
    a ∈ s ↔ ∃ (ι : Type u) (_hι : Nonempty ι) (f : ι → Ordinal),
      (∀ i, f i ∈ s) ∧ sup.{u, u} f = a
